variants.text: The rows meet over deep water and there is nothing to stand on. Whatever cut these off level did it with an edge, and the only edge in the marsh that will do it is in Reedy Bottom.
Straight rows in a marsh, converging on a spot with nothing at it. You would want the bill to open a way, and you would want to have thought about what else uses it.
No leeches here. Nowhere else in Thornmere is there nowhere without leeches.
